messages.subject: Wassim | GCC Energy & Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Wassim,

Your role as Managing Partner of Stanton Chase in the Middle East, together with your work across Industrial, Energy, Resources & Mining and Sustainability & ESG, makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness. I work directly across ministries, regulators, communities and technical functions to translate external expectations into accountable internal execution.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am open to wider GCC expatriate and regional assignments.

I have attached a Stanton Chase GCC-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for current or upcoming searches where this background aligns.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
